audience_accounts: CREATE TABLE audience_accounts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data_json TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
audience_devices: CREATE TABLE audience_devices(credential_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,revoked_at INTEGER)
audience_announcements: CREATE TABLE audience_announcements(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,account_id TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)
audience_recovery_keys: CREATE TABLE audience_recovery_keys(credential_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,revoked_at INTEGER)
audience_artist_links: CREATE TABLE audience_artist_links(account_id TEXT NOT NULL,artist_id TEXT NOT NULL,claim_id TEXT,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(account_id,artist_id))
audience_artist_claims: CREATE TABLE audience_artist_claims(claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,artist_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,linked_at INTEGER,detached_at INTEGER)
audience_deletions: CREATE TABLE audience_deletions(account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,deleted_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
artist_deletions: CREATE TABLE artist_deletions(artist_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,channel_id TEXT,deleted_at TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL)
audience_notification_reads: CREATE TABLE audience_notification_reads(account_id TEXT NOT NULL,notification_key TEXT NOT NULL,read_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(account_id,notification_key))
artist_deletion_accounts: CREATE TABLE artist_deletion_accounts(artist_id TEXT NOT NULL,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(artist_id,account_id))
artist_claims:
CREATE TABLE artist_claims (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  artist_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  whatsapp TEXT,
  proof_url TEXT,
  social_url TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewed_at TEXT,
  review_note TEXT
)
artist_owners:
CREATE TABLE artist_owners (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, artist_id TEXT NOT NULL, claim_id TEXT, contact_email TEXT,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owner', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  verification_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin_approved',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT
)
audience_recovery_epochs: CREATE TABLE audience_recovery_epochs(account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES audience_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=0))
